summary: Bounded independent review of 38 owned Chinese units, 64 owned items and 18 owned people, including the two read-only Duan Liao context rows. Most current repairs are supported: by-304 recruitment, 304–314 provincial context, 314–318 invitation, retrospective ancient citations excluded from active hints, AD 341 promotion, 341–342 design/Goguryeo uncertainty, AD 344 Yuwen planning, and death at 62 sui within 344–348 without an inferred birth year. One precise capital-move row incorrectly selects AD 342 over the conflicting native AD 341 witness. Six claim rows and three hint rows remain research-blocked on Xiankang-4 twelfth-month calendar normalization after the reliable converter failed to serve a result. Yang Yu’s intervening provincial transfer needs a personal chronology attestation. Every owned unit was read for birth/death/age/date omissions; no additional explicit numerical age or birth date was found. This is neither full-chapter nor publication approval. Only the supplied en field was checked for English defects; literal and other unavailable fields and repeated uses outside the sealed packet remain unchecked.
